controls.inline: async function load(){if(loading)return;loading=true;refresh.disabled=true;grid.replaceChildren();grid.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');const text=document.createElement('p');text.textContent='正在打开相册…';text.setAttribute('role','status');grid.append(text);await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,400));grid.removeAttribute('aria-busy');loading=false;refresh.disabled=false;if(UI.failNext('photo-load')){grid.replaceChildren();const box=document.createElement('div');box.className='prototype-photo-empty';const title=document.createElement('h2');title.textContent='相册暂时打不开';const retry=document.createElement('button');retry.textContent='重试加载';retry.onclick=load;box.append(title,retry);grid.append(box);}else render();}
